pieces.text: Joanne Lockner - Democrat. District 22: Aurora, Buffalo,
Hand, Jerauld, Sanborn and part of Spink counties. Address: RR
2, Box 102, Wessington, SD 57381-8932. Born: May 19, 1937, St.
Lawrence, SD. Married: Frank O. Lockner. Children: Dean and
Clifford. Farmer. Lutheran. St. Lawrence High School, 1955.
Former bank teller at First National Bank, Miller and Bank of
Wessington. Treasurer, Hand County Democrats, 1976-82; vice-
Delegate to Democratic State Convention, 1992; co-chair, Labor
Outstanding Young Women of America by Wessington Women's
Study Club. Eastern Star; Yelduz Shrine Auxiliary; Dakota Image
Art Group; Trinity Lutheran Church Women. Representative 1993-

text:
Joanne Lockner - Democrat. District 22: Aurora, Buffalo,
Hand, Jerauld, Sanborn and part of Spink counties. Address: RR
2, Box 102, Wessington, SD 57381-8932. Born: May 19, 1937, St.
Lawrence, SD. Married: Frank O. Lockner. Children: Dean and
Clifford. Farmer. Lutheran. St. Lawrence High School, 1955.
Former bank teller at First National Bank, Miller and Bank of
Wessington. Treasurer, Hand County Democrats, 1976-82; vice-
chair, 1982-86; chair, 1986-88; State Committee Women, 1988-92.
Delegate to Democratic State Convention, 1992; co-chair, Labor
and Employment Platform Committee, 1992. Nominated 1971
Outstanding Young Women of America by Wessington Women's
Study Club. Eastern Star; Yelduz Shrine Auxiliary; Dakota Image
Art Group; Trinity Lutheran Church Women. Representative 1993-
